title: On the open Duo, can the Suspense line hold several names, not one?
ref: debt duo-hand-mockup-gaps; decision duo-card-in-hand; lane duo-gaps-design-review (PR 237)
context:
Goal: an envelope with no sender can still be checked in on the Duo.
Problem (rule): decision new-envelope-ends-an-envelope rules on "a name held", and HandModel holds one name. Parts 5 and 8, and part 7's Hold in Suspense, need several.
Based on (read): docs/design/duo-hand-gaps-notes.md, Owner grant items 1.
Departs from: main HandModel.held, one name — a list of names with copies, cleared by New envelope.
Asked by lane duo-gaps-design-review (PR 237, mockup docs/design/duo-hand-gaps.html at 4362dc5). The picks per part live in docs/design/duo-hand-gaps-notes.md.

options.label: Yes, several names
options.how: The Suspense line holds a list of names with copies. New envelope clears it.
options.gain: Parts 5 and 8 work, and mail with no sender gets checked in.
options.lose: More held state to show and to clear.

options.label: No, keep one name
options.how: The held line keeps one name, as today.
options.lose: Part 8 and part 7's Hold drop out; part 5 marks one card only.

why: It is the only way mail with no sender gets checked in on the Duo.
holds: Building parts 5 and 8, and part 7's Hold in Suspense, waits on this.
